description: Connects a domain to a website Buildly hosts: the bare domain to Buildly's fixed address, which sends visitors on to www, and www to the site. Two optional TXT records validate the www certificate ahead of time when the domain already serves a live site.
variableDescription: ownership: the TXT value proving ownership of www (Cloudflare for SaaS); acme: the TXT value validating its TLS certificate. Both are used only by the optional verify group.
